name: Lumify Sports Intelligence API
description:
Lumify is an agent-ready sports intelligence API: schedules, live scores, odds,
public betting splits, and AI-powered bet intelligence (confidence scores,
signal breakdowns, and LLM-generated narratives) across MLB, tennis, soccer
(MLS, EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, and UEFA
Champions League), NFL, NCAAF, NCAAB, NBA, and NHL.

## Authentication
All `/v1/*` endpoints require a Bearer API key:

    Authorization: Bearer lmfy-xxxxxx.yyyyyyyy...

Create an account and first key in the [dashboard](https://lumify.ai/api-keys);
subsequent keys and credit top-ups are available via `/api/agent/*`. Errors follow a
single [envelope](https://lumify.ai/docs/reference#error-codes) with a machine-readable
`error.code`. Billing blocks return `402` (`insufficient_credits`,
`daily_credit_cap_exceeded`, or `payment_failed`) — not `401`. Responses include
`X-RateLimit-*` and `X-Credits-*` headers.

## For AI agents
- Overview: [/llms.txt](https://lumify.ai/llms.txt)
- GEO orientation (coverage, pricing, FAQ): [/llms-full.txt](https://lumify.ai/llms-full.txt)
- Full technical reference: [/docs/llms-full.txt](https://lumify.ai/docs/llms-full.txt)
- Model Context Protocol server: connect to `https://lumify.ai/mcp`
- OpenAPI schema: [/openapi.json](https://lumify.ai/openapi.json)
